Short sleeves and a round neck keep the look open and breathable for warm days; the floor-length skirt provides full coverage for comfortable movement   Two Side Pockets — Pockets fit most phones, keys, and small essentials. The hem falls to ankle length on most heights; check the size chart for exact back-length measurements by size   Easy to Style — Wear with flat sandals and a crossbody bag for daily errands; add a denim jacket and low wedges for weekend brunch. How is the KARALIN dress different from other long dresses?
This dress is designed specifically for curvy figures, made from soft fabric, and features practical side pockets and a flowing silhouette. Lightweight and breathable, it's available in a variety of stylish colors and is durable and washable.
What occasions can I wear this dress to?
It is highly versatile. Great for daily errands, beach trips and travel. You can also pair it with heels for brunch, parties and formal events. Suitable for spring, summer and mild autumn.
Do the pockets actually work? Can I carry small items in them?
Definitely. The deep side pockets are durable and functional to hold phones, keys and other small belongings. They won’t affect the overall look of the dress.
I’m curvy, will this dress fit my body shape well?
Yes. Designed for sizes XL-4XL, the loose cut and stretch fabric fit curves nicely without tightness. It offers all-day comfort and flatters different body shapes.
What shoes or accessories pair best with this maxi dress?
It’s easy to style. Match with sandals, sneakers and crossbody bags for casual looks. Choose wedges, block heels and jewelry for formal occasions. You can also layer with a denim jacket or thin cardigan on cool days.
customer_review_summary: Customers find the dress flattering, with one mentioning it hits right at the ankles, and they appreciate its beautiful print and get compliments every time they wear it. The dress features high-quality t-shirt material, softness, and pockets, with one customer noting the nice pocket height. While the length receives mixed feedback, with some finding it great while others say it's over a foot too long, and opinions about sizing are divided between those who find it the right size and those who say it runs big, customers like the rich colors, particularly the deep dark purple shade.

top_reviews.title: PERFECT!!!!
top_reviews.body: This dress is absolutely beautiful. It looks just like the picture. They were out of the size that amazon recommended for me so instead of a 20 I ordered an 18 and it fits great. I'm so pleased! The material is soft and the colors are vibrant. I love that it hides all my insecurities without looking like a big/baggy dress. I'm 5'8" and it doesn't quite reach my ankles but it still looks good. I'm about 225-230lbs and a size 18 fits great, I dare say that it's even a tiny bit big/roomy.

top_reviews.title: Such a soft and durable long dress
top_reviews.body: This is a long dress with no bling on it. It is lightweight, non form fitting dress. Can be dressed up for more formal locations and can be left as if you are going no where special. It is great for the summer and not too bad in the winter. However with it being lightweight it is also somewhat see through. Pantaloons or Slips would be good underneath.

top_reviews.title: Fits beautifully but extremely long
top_reviews.body: I bought this for my mom's funeral, it fit beautifully. I'm 5'10 and it hit the ground, so if you're short it's definitely going to need to be hemmed.

top_reviews.title: Nice dress, but beware the length
top_reviews.body: I ordered 2, one green and one black, and the dress is generally a fair value for its price. The fabric is soft and flowing, it feels very nice, and the style is flattering. However, as some reviews state, it is definitely on the long side; at 5'4", I am not a short woman, but I can't wear it with confidence even in heels. In addition, the shoulder seams are wider apart than I prefer because that distance affects the fit of the sleeves as well. I really wanted this dress to be "the one" but it wasn't to be. Sadly, I will be returning these items.

top_reviews.title: Very nice! Comfort.and style.Great length!
top_reviews.body: Good quality dress! I'm tall, 5' 10" and 195lbs. The dress is floor length! I love it! Being tall it's hard to find maxi dresses that are true maxis. The material is.very soft and.bouncy. Very comfortable with a great fit. I got.the olive green with tiny leaf print. Very pretty!
